title: Puella Magi Oriko★Magica
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A two-volume spin-off of Puella Magi Madoka Magica. Oriko, a magical girl who can see the future, foresees devastation tied to Madoka and, to stop it, steers the contract-making creature Kyubey toward Yuma, a young orphan taken in by Kyoko, while a killer of magical girls stalks the town (Yen Press blurb; ANN and UK Anime Network reviews). Oriko's devoted companion Kirika and an expanded role for Mami drive a dark, tense plot.
life_message: It questions whether saving the world can justify sacrificing innocents, and holds up protective love for the vulnerable.
